insights: Shorts vastly outperform long-form content, with 12 of 19 Shorts reaching over 1,000 views, whereas long-form data is thin (only 4 videos) and struggles with 25-36% retention and a 510-view ceiling.
'Myth vs fact' is the most engaging script style, driving the highest retention rates in the dataset (89% for Maglev and 114% for Artemis).
'Shocking fact first' consistently drives high view counts and strong retention, yielding the top-performing Short (US Army Robots, 1,918 views) and highest retention (Europa Probe, 167% AVP).

Critical retention drop-offs routinely occur between 4.8 and 6.9 seconds across nearly all Shorts (losing 3-9% of viewers), indicating hooks must deliver the primary intrigue before the 5-second mark.
Direct mid-video or end-of-video channel call-to-actions drastically hurt retention; pitching 'The full breakdown is on our channel' triggered a 23.4% viewer drop.

Robotics/military tech and space topics dominate viewer interest (peaking at 1,500-1,900+ views), while environmental/niche infrastructure topics (e.g., cloud seeding at 235 views, underwater air at 51 views) underperform.

Closing questions consistently fail to stimulate interaction, as 17 out of 23 videos received zero comments; the bot should transition from generic wrap-ups to polarizing or open-ended debate questions.
